## What's new

- Screenshots in the in-game menu opens on the one you looked at last
  (the newest the first time), so a password is two presses away.
- No more "hold Y to hide" in the screenshot viewer.

---

ChaOS 0.9.9 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.9-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.9-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
